en: The borrowings will comply with the grammar of the recipient language.
zh: 借词要符合接受者语言的语法。

en: Well, from the point of view of linguistics, borrowing is a manifestation of of how languages change and how they interact.
zh: 从语言学的角度来看，借词是语言如何变化以及它们如何相互作用的一种表现。

en: So the task that we propose is to detect unassimilated lexical borrowings in Spanish newswire.
zh: 因此，我们提出的任务是检测西班牙语新闻专线中未同化的词汇借用。

en: There has been previous word on Anglicism detection ah which consists consisted of a CRF model for Anglicism detection on Spanish Newswire.
zh: 之前已经有关于英语检测的单词，由西班牙语新闻专线上用于英语检测的CRF模型组成。

en: This prevented the assessment of whether the modeling approach could actually generalize to previously unseen borrowings.
zh: 这使我们无法评估建模方法是否可以实际概括到以前未见过的借词。

en: In fact, ninety two percent of the borrowings in the test set are OOV.
zh: 事实上，测试集中92%的借词都是OOV。

en: We use CONLL formats and we used BIO encoding so that we could encode ah single token borrowings such as app or multi token borrowings such as machine learning.
zh: 我们使用CONLL格式和BIO编码，这样我们就可以编码单个令牌借词，比如app，或多个令牌借词，比如machine learning。

en: And we have annotated it using the BIO um encode.
zh: 而且我们已经使用BIO编码对其进行了注释。

en: So the BIO was used for words in Spanish so not for words that were not borrowed.
zh: 因此，BIO用于西班牙语中的单词，而不是用于未借用的单词。

en: These are binary features such as the word or the token in upper case?
zh: 这些都是二进制特征，例如大写的单词或令牌？

en: We obtain fifty five F1 score using the the CRF model with handcrafted features.
zh: 我们使用具有手工制作特征的CRF模型获得55分的F1分数。

en: Which is a huge different difference um compared to the reported F1 score of eighty six, which was the result obtained with the same CRF model, same features but on a different dataset also for Spanish lexical borrowing detection.
zh: 与报告的86分F1分数相比，这是一个巨大的差异，F1分数是用相同的CRF模型，相同的特征，但是在不同的数据集上获得的结果，也用于西班牙语词汇借用检测。

en: We used BETO which is a monolingual BERT model trained for Spanish and also multilingual BERT.
zh: 我们使用了BETO，这是一个单语BERT模型，针对西班牙语和多语言BERT训练的模型。

en: Both models we use them through the transformers library by HuggingFace.
zh: 我们通过HuggingFace的转换器库使用这两个模型。

en: As you can see, multilingual BERT performs better than BETO both on the development set and on the test set and across all metrics.
zh: 正如大家所看到的，多语言BERT在开发集和测试集以及所有指标上的表现都优于BETO。

en: Just so we have ah an idea to compare, the CRF model obtained an eighty two.
zh: 正因为如此，我们有了一个比较的想法，CRF模型获得了82分。

en: The CRF model obtained a fifty five obtained a fifty five F1 score, whereas the multilingual BERT obtained eighty two, which is a big difference.
zh: CRF模型获得了55分，获得了55分的F1分数，而多语言BERT获得了82分，这是一个很大的差异。

en: What we found out was that transformer-based embeddings performed better than non contextualized embeddings, that the combination of English BERT and Spanish BETO embeddings outperform multilingual BERT embeddings.
zh: 我们发现，基于转换器的嵌入比非情境化的嵌入表现得更好，英语BERT和西班牙语BETO嵌入的组合比多语言BERT嵌入表现得更好。

en: And that BPE embeddings produced better F1 and character embeddings produce better recall.
zh: BPE嵌入产生了更好的F1，字符嵌入产生了更好的调用。

en: One was fed with BETO and BERT embeddings and BPE, and the other one BETO and BERT embeddings and BPE and also character embeddings.
zh: 一个是BETO和BERT 嵌入和BPE，另一个是BETO和BERT嵌入和BPE，还有字符嵌入。

en: So, we run the same BiLSTM-CRF model that we had run using flare, but instead of using these unadapted transformer-based BETO and BERT embeddings, we used code switch embeddings.
zh: 因此，我们运行了使用flare运行的相同的BiLSTM-CRF模型，但我们使用了语码转换嵌入，而不是使用这些未调整的基于转换器的BETO和BERT嵌入。

en: Well these are um embeddings that are have been fine tuned transformer-based embeddings that have been pretrained for language identification on the Spanish English section of the LinCE code switching dataset.
zh: 这些是经过微调的基于转换器的嵌入，这些嵌入已经在LinCE语码转换数据集的西班牙语英语部分经过预训练 用于 语言识别。

en: LinCE is a dataset on code switching that has a section on Spanish English, Spanish English code switching.
zh: LinCE是一个关于语码转换的数据集，其中有一个关于西班牙语英语，西班牙语英语语码转换的部分。

en: So we fed our BiLSTM-CRF with code switch embeddings and optionally character embeddings, BPE embeddings and so on.
zh: 因此，我们给我们的BiLSTM-CRF提供了语码转换嵌入和可选的字符嵌入、BPE嵌入等等。

en: We have ah we have produced a new dataset of Spanish newswire that is annotated with unassimilated lexical borrowings.
zh: 我们已经创建了一个新的西班牙语新闻专线数据集，使用未同化的词汇借词进行了注释。

en: This dataset is more borrowing dense and OOV-rich than previous resources.
zh: 与之前的资源相比，这个数据集的借词密度更高，并且OOV也更丰富。

en: Also interestingly, BPE embeddings seem to improve F1 score.
zh: 同样有趣的是，BPE嵌入似乎提高了F1分数。

en: I am presenting our paper KinyaBERT: a Morphology-aware Kinyarwanda Language Model.
zh: 我将介绍我们的论文《KinyaBERT：一种形态学意识的基尼亚卢旺达语语言模型》。

en: Then I'll present KinyaBERT model architecture in detail.
zh: 然后，我将详细介绍KinyaBERT模型的架构。

en: We all know that recent natural language processing advances have been made possible by the use of pretrained language models such as BERT.
zh: 我们都知道，最近的自然语言处理进步是通过使用预训练语言模型（如BERT ）实现的。

en: Due to the complex morphology that is expressed by most morphologically rich languages, the ubiquitous byte pair encoding tokenization algorithm that I used cannot extract the exact subword lexical units, meaning the morphemes, which are needed for effective representation.
zh: 由于大多数形态学上丰富的语言所表达的形态学很复杂，我使用的普遍存在的字节对编码标记化算法无法提取有效表达所需的确切子词词汇单位，即意义语素。

en: For example, here we have three Kinyarwanda words that have several morphemes in them, but the BPE algorithms cannot extract them.
zh: 例如，这里我们有三个基尼亚卢旺达语单词，其中有几个语素，但BPE算法无法提取它们。

en: This is because some morphological rules produce different surface forms that hide the exact lexical information, and BPE, which is solely based on the surface forms, does not have access to this lexical model.
zh: 这是因为某些形态化规则产生不同的表面形式，隐藏了确切的词汇信息，而完全基于表面形式的BPE无法访问此词汇模型。

en: The second challenge is that even if one had access to an oracle morphological analyzer, replacing BPE tokens with morphemes is not enough to express the morphological compositionality.
zh: 第二个挑战是，即使人们能够使用甲骨文形态化分析器，用语素替换BPE令牌也不足以表达形态学组合性。

en: Therefore, we present KinyaBERT, which is a simple but effective adaptation of the BERT architecture that is meant to more effectively handle morphologically rich languages.
zh: 所以，我们提出KinyaBERT，它是BERT架构的一个简单但有效的改编，旨在更有效地处理形态上丰富的语言。

en: We evaluate KinyaBERT on Kinyarwanda, a low resource morphologically rich language, which is spoken by more than twelve million people across Eastern and Central Africa.
zh: 我们评估了基尼亚卢旺达语的KinyaBERT，这是一种低资源形态上丰富的语言，在东非和中非有超过1200万人使用。

en: The affixes may indicate tense, aspect, subject or object in verbs, and more often relates to the Bantu noun class for subjects and objects.
zh: 词缀可以表示动词中的时态、方面、主语或宾语，更多时候与班图语的名词类主语和宾语有关。

en: The output of the are the vectors that are contextualized with the morphological information at each word.
zh: 它们的输出是情境化的向量，每个单词都有形态化的信息。

en: The final output are contextualized embeddings that can be used for downstream NLP tasks.
zh: 最终输出是情境化嵌入，可用于下游自然语言处理任务。

en: We effectively model the morphology of all Kinyarwanda words, including verbals, nouns, demonstrative and possessive pronouns, numerals, and others.
zh: 我们有效地对所有基尼亚卢旺达语单词的形态进行建模，包括动词、名词、指示和所有格代词、数字等等。

en: We use an unsupervised part of speech tagging algorithm.
zh: 我们使用语音标记算法的无监督部分。

en: We also take into consideration the part of speech tag precedence as well as the syntactic agreements that are present in the in the input words.
zh: 我们还考虑了部分语音标签的优先顺序，以及输入单词中存在的句法协议。

en: The part of speech tagger uses a bidi bidirectional inference which improves upon the more often used Viterbi algorithm for decoding.
zh: 部分语音标记器使用bidi双向推理，这种方法改进了更经常用于解码的Viterbi算法。

en: Second, the sentence encoder uses the so-called untied relative positional embeddings, which have been recently published at ICLR conference.
zh: 第二，句子编码器使用所谓的不受约束的相对位置嵌入，这是最近在ICLR会议上发表的。

en: This positional embeddings essentially disentangles positional correlations from token to token attention computation.
zh: 这种位置嵌入本质上将位置相关性从令牌分离到令牌注意力计算。

en: Similar to BERT, we use a masked language model pre-training objective.
zh: 与BERT类似，我们使用掩码语言模型预训练目标。

en: We pre-train KinyaBERT on about two and half gigabytes of Kinyarwanda text, and compare it to three baseline models.
zh: 我们用大约2.5千兆字节的基尼亚卢旺达语文本对KinyaBERT进行预训练，并将其与三个基线模型进行比较。

en: One is a multilingual model called XLM-R, that is trained on a large text corpora that is made of multiple languages.
zh: 一个是称为XLM-R的多语言模型，它是在由多种语言组成的大型文本语料库上训练的。

en: All models are configured in the base architecture, which is about between a hundred and a hundred and ten million parameters, with Kinyarwanda with KinyaBERT using the least number of parameters.
zh: 所有模型都是在基础架构中配置的，基础架构的参数大约在100到1000万之间，基尼亚卢旺达语和KinyaBERT使用的参数数量最少。

en: All models except the multilingual are pretrained for thirty two thousand gradient updates with a batch size of two thousand five hundred and sixty sequences in each batch.
zh: 除多语言外，所有模型都经过预训练用于32000梯度更新，每批次的批量大小为2560序列。

en: One is the GLUE benchmark which has often been used for evaluating the effectiveness of pretrained language models.
zh: 其中一个是GLUE基准，它经常用于评估预训练语言模型的有效性。

en: We obtain our GLUE benchmark data by translating the original benchmark data into Kinyarwanda using Google Translate.
zh: 我们通过使用Google翻译将原始基准数据翻译成基尼亚卢旺达语来获得GLUE基准数据。

en: For the GLUE benchmark, we find that KinyaBERT consistently outperforms baseline models.
zh: 对于GLUE基准，我们发现KinyaBERT始终优于基线模型。

en: We also run a user evaluation of the translations that are produced by Google Translate.
zh: 我们还对Google翻译生成的翻译进行了用户评估。

en: Essentially, user users rated about six thousand examples, assigning scores on a scale from one to four, assessing the quality of the translations.
zh: 基本上，用户用户对大约6000个例子进行了评分，按照从1到4的等级进行评分，评估翻译的质量。

en: The result is that many translations were noisy.
zh: 其结果是，许多翻译是杂乱无章的。

en: But, all models had to cope with the same translation noise, and the relative performance between the models is still important to notice.
zh: 但是，所有模型都必须应对相同的翻译噪声，并且模型之间的相对性能仍然是值得注意的重要因素。

en: For the named entity recognition task, we also find that KinyaBERT gives the best performance with the affix distribution regression variant performing best.
zh: 对于命名实体识别任务，我们还发现KinyaBERT给出的表现最好，并且词缀分布回归变体表现最佳。

en: We also conducted an ablation study to see if there are alternative structures that improve performance.
zh: 我们还进行了一项消融研究，看看是否有其他结构可以提高表现。

en: For the GLUE benchmark, we find that using affix sets consistently performs better, while affix probability regression objective yields the best performance on named entity recognition.
zh: 对于GLUE基准，我们发现使用词缀集始终表现更好，而词缀概率回归目标在命名实体识别上产生最佳表现。

en: Also by looking at the low scores for finetuning, we find that KinyaBERT has better convergence in most cases.
zh: 此外，通过查看微调的低分数，我们发现KinyaBERT在大多数情况下具有更好的收敛性。

en: The proposed two tier transformer encoder architecture enables capturing morphological complexity morphological compositionality, which is an important aspect of morphologically rich languages.
zh: 所提出的两层转换器编码器架构能够捕获形态学复杂性形态学组合性，这是形态学丰富语言的一个重要方面。

en: Next, weights are calculated using boosted softmax over scores.
zh: 接下来，使用分数上的提升softmax计算权重。

en: After each tournament round, new vectors and scores are composed as a linear combination of those pairs with the obtained weights.
zh: 在每一轮锦标赛之后，新的向量和分数被组成为这些对与所获得的权重的线性组合。

en: So in short, we combine them linearly by performing a softmax over their scores.
zh: 因此，简而言之，我们通过对它们的分数执行softmax来线性地组合它们。

en: The qual quality qual qualitative comparison of our trend pyramidion to other baseline is performed on the long document summarization task, or given the body of an article from arXiv or PubMed, the task is to generate its abstract.
zh: 我们的趋势金字塔与其他基线的qual质量qual定性比较是在长文档总结任务上执行的，或者给定来自arXiv或PubMed的文章主体，而任务是生成其摘要。

en: Both models have much lower parameter counts and were trained from scratch on the chosen tasks.
zh: 这两个模型的参数计数要低得多，并且都是根据所选的任务从头开始训练的。

en: Previous approaches to to achieve a similar performance had to use more parameters and leverage pretrained foundation foundational models and additional language pretraining objective to achieve similar performance.
zh: 之前实现类似表现的方法必须使用更多的参数，并利用预训练基础模型和额外的语言预训练目标来实现类似的表现。

en: I am very glad to present our work on Online Semantic Parsing for Latency Reduction in Task-Oriented Dialogue.
zh: 我很高兴向大家介绍我们在在线语义解析用于减少面向任务的对话中的延迟方面的工作。

en: In task-oriented dialogue, a user interacts with the system that handles requests from user utterances usually in speaking.
zh: 在面向任务的对话中，用户通常在说话时与处理来自用户话语请求的系统进行交互。

en: Because the program is represented as a semantic graph that outlines the computation, where node represents a function invocation and its children are the arguments.
zh: 因为该程序被表示为概述计算的语义图形，其中节点表示一个函数调用，而其子节点是参数。

en: Examples include simultaneous translation where a live interpreter translates one language to another in real time, smart text auto completion to guess the user intent, and Uber pool where the drivers are sent to where they might be needed based on the predicted demand.
zh: 例如，同步翻译，其中现场翻译人员实时将一种语言翻译成另一种语言，智能文本自动补全功能用于猜测用户意图；再比如优步拼车，根据预测的需求将司机送到可能需要的地方。

en: At the position of at the pool party with Barack Obama, we got a graph with the right nodes on the person and the event subject, but guess the wrong timing information.
zh: 在与Barack Obama的泳池派对上，我们得到了一张关于人物和事件主题正确节点的图表，但猜错了时间信息。

en: Next, the node create event can then get executed after obtaining results from lower level nodes and then the top function yield so the whole program is finished.
zh: 接下来，在获得下层节点的结果后，节点创建事件可以得到执行，然后顶层函数产生，从而完成整个程序。

en: Such as the event time here where AM is also anticipated correctly.
zh: 比如这里的事件时间，对上午的预测也是正确的。

en: In particular, the prefix after Obama is first completed through a finetuned BART language model and then translated into a program with full offline parser.
zh: 具体来说，Obama之后的前缀首先是通过一个微调过的BART语言模型完成的，然后转换为具有完全离线解析器的程序。

en: We select confidence subgraphs based on the thresholding heuristic to be executed.
zh: 我们根据要执行的阈值启发式选择置信度子图。

en: For formal evaluation of the online methods, we propose final latency reduction or FLR metric.
zh: 对于在线方法的正式评估，我们提出最终延迟减少或FLR指标。

en: In online systems, execution overlaps with the utterance timeline, so it ends earlier.
zh: 在在线系统中，执行与话语时间线重叠，因此会提前结束。

en: FLR is defined as the reduction time compared to the offline system, marked by the end of the execution.
zh: FLR被定义为与离线系统相比的减少时间，以执行结束为标志。

en: We conduct experiments on two large conversational semantic parsing datasets, SMCalFlow and TreeDST.
zh: 我们在两个大的会话式语义解析数据集上进行了实验，即SMCalFlow和TreeDST。

en: The LM complete model also achieves nontrivial BLEU gain compared with the simple baseline of node completion.
zh: 与节点完成的简单基线相比，LM完成模型也达到了非平凡的BLEU增益。

en: The curves show the tradeoff between the FLR metric and the execution cost, measured by the number of excessive function costs that are not correct.
zh: 这些曲线显示了FLR指标和执行成本之间的权衡，通过不正确的超额函数成本的数量来衡量。

en: A higher threshold selects fewer functions of mistake, but obtains a smaller FLR, whereas the lower threshold more aggressively selects and executes programs.
zh: 较高的阈值选择较少的错误函数，但获得较小的FLR，而较低的阈值更积极地选择和执行程序。

en: The upper left region is has the best FLR and cost tradeoff.
zh: 左上区域具有最佳FLR和成本权衡。

en: We see both of our methods beat the baseline by a large margin, and they perform more similarly on TreeDST.
zh: 我们看到我们的两种方法都以很大的幅度击败了基线，并且它们在TreeDST上的表现更加相似。

en: When individual function execution is slower, there is more room for FLR improvement.
zh: 当单个函数的执行速度较慢时，FLR的改进空间较大。

en: Moreover, our approach can be a general framework and can be applied to other executable semantic representations in different domains.
zh: 而且，我们的方法可以是一个通用框架，并且可以应用于不同域中的其他可执行语义表示。

en: I'm going to discuss our work on generating retrieval augmented counterfactuals for question answering tasks.
zh: 我将讨论我们在为问题回答任务生成检索增强型反事实方面的工作。

en: For instance, changing the words fascinating to captivating or expected to mind-numbing changes the sentiment for this movie review.
zh: 例如，将单词“引人入胜”改为“令人着迷”，或将“意料之中”改为“单调无聊”，就会改变这篇电影评论的情绪。

en: This could be done by human annotation, but this is expensive and biased.
zh: 这可以通过人类注释来完成，但这样做不仅昂贵，而且还带有偏见。

en: Some prior work has focused on using syntax trees or semantic role labeling.
zh: 之前的一些工作侧重于使用句法树或语义角色标签。

en: We propose a very simple yet effective technique called retrieve generate filter or RGF, to tackle counterfactual perturbations of questions, and also aims to tackle all the other aforementioned challenges.
zh: 我们提出一种非常简单但有效的技术，称为检索生成过滤器或RGF，以解决问题的反事实扰动，并旨在解决上述所有其他挑战。

en: The core intuition behind RGF is that the necessary background information that is needed to generate perturbations may be present in the near misses made by a question answering model.
zh: RGF背后的核心直觉是，产生扰动所需的必要背景信息可能存在于问题回答模型造成的未遂事件中。

en: For instance, the state-of-the-art model REALM produces the following top k answers to the question who is the captain of the Richmond Football Club?
zh: 例如，最先进的模型REALM为“谁是里士满足球俱乐部的队长”这个问题提供以下前k个回答？

en: To summarize, RGF first retrieves top k most relevant answers and contexts which don't match the reference answer in context.
zh: 总而言之，RGF首先检索前k个最相关的回答和上下文中与参考回答不匹配的上下文。

en: Going over each step in greater detail for retrieval, we use a retrieve then read model like REALM that takes as input the original question, and a large corpus like Wikipedia.
zh: 更详细地检查检索的每个步骤，我们使用检索然后读取模型，如REALM，将原始问题作为输入，并使用像维基百科这样的大型语料库。

en: REALM retrieves the gold passage and answer in most cases.
zh: 在大多数情况下，REALM会检索黄金段落和回答。

en: In the next step, question generation, we use these alternate answers and contexts to regenerate new questions that correspond to these alternatives.
zh: 在下一步问题生成中，我们使用这些备选回答和上下文来重新生成与这些备选回答相对应的新问题。

en: For example, for the query who is the captain of the Richmond Football Club? REALM retrieves passages about the club's women's team, captained by Jess Kennedy, and the question generation model generates the query who captained Richmond Football Club's first ever women's team?
zh: 例如，对于“谁是里士满足球俱乐部的队长？”这个询问，REALM检索由Jess Kennedy担任队长的俱乐部女队的段落，而问题生成模型生成询问“谁是里士满足球俱乐部有史以来第一支女子足球队的队长？”

en: In a similar fashion, we also get queries like who captained Richmond's VFL Reserve team?
zh: 通过类似的方式，我们也会得到一些这样的询问，比如“谁是里士满VFL预备队的队长？”

en: For filtering techniques that doesn't require additional supervision, we simply retain new questions that have a small token label edit distance from the original question.
zh: 对于不需要额外监督的过滤技术，我们只需保留与原始问题有较小令牌标签编辑距离的新问题。

en: Because it has a longer edit distance from the original question.
zh: 因为它与原始问题有一个较长的编辑距离。

en: In our experiments, we demonstrate that this simple heuristic can be used to augment and queue training data.
zh: 在我们的实验中，我们证明了这个简单的启发式可以用来增强训练数据并将其排入队列。

en: To this end, we use a general purpose query decomposition framework called QED.
zh: 为此，我们使用了一个名为QED的通用询问分解框架。

en: QED identifies two parts to the question, a predicate and a reference.
zh: QED确定问题的两个部分，一个是谓词，一个是引用。

en: A model trained on reference predicate annotations for NQ gives us this question decomposition.
zh: 在NQ的引用谓词注释上训练的模型为我们提供了这个问题的分解。

en: Decomposing both the original and generated question based on QED allows us to categorize our generated counterfactuals for evaluation.
zh: 根据QED分解原始问题和生成的问题，使我们能够对生成的反事实进行分类评估。

en: Those that undergo a reference change while retaining predicates, and those that undergo a predicate change and optionally add references.
zh: 在保留谓词的同时进行引用更改的问题，以及进行谓词更改并可选地添加引用的问题。

en: For instance, who captained Richmond's VFL reserve team is a reference change?
zh: 例如，“谁是里士满VFL预备队的队长？”是进行引用更改。

en: We now evaluate the effectiveness of RGF perturbations when augmented to training data.
zh: 我们现在评估当增强到训练数据时RGF扰动的有效性。

en: The first baseline, called random answer and question generation, adds data that has no relation with the original question.
zh: 第一个基线称为随机回答和问题生成，添加了与原始问题没有关系的数据。

en: How base how do the baselines and RGF ah augmentation perform on reading comprehension where the model has access to question and context?
zh: 在模型能够访问问题和上下文的情况下，基线和RGF增强在阅读理解方面的表现如何？

en: We find that both data augmentation baselines are not able to improve our domain generalization.
zh: 我们发现两个数据增强基线都无法改善我们的域泛化。

en: Comparing against that baseline, we find that RGF counterfactuals are able to improve out of domain performance while maintaining in domain performance.
zh: 与基线相比，我们发现RGF反事实能够提高域外表现，同时保持域内表现。

en: Furthermore, we find that using retrieval to sample alternative outcomes or answers is important for effective CDA.
zh: 此外，我们发现，使用检索对备选结果或回答进行抽样，对于有效的CDA非常重要。

en: We also experiment with open domain QA setting where the model only sees the question and once again we evaluate on four out of domain datasets.
zh: 我们还尝试了开放域 问答设置，其中模型只看到问题，然后我们再次对域数据集中的四个数据集进行评估。

en: We find that baseline models are not as effective for out of domain generalization.
zh: 我们发现基线模型对域外泛化并不那么有效。

en: However, data augmentation with RGF shows more significant improvements.
zh: 然而，使用RGF的数据增强显示出更显著的改进。

en: This explicitly helps us to measure the model's robustness to small perturbations in the neighborhood of the original input.
zh: 这显然有助于我们衡量模型对原始输入邻域中的小扰动的鲁棒性。

en: Apart from the three datasets AQA, AmbigQA and QUOREF-Contrast set that are already available, we also evaluate on RGF counterfactuals that are paired with original NQ questions based on whether they underwent a predicate change or reference change.
zh: 除了已经可用的三个数据集AQA、AmbigQA和QUOREF-对比集之外，我们还根据RGF反事实与原始NQ问题配对，评估它们是否经历了谓词变化或引用变化。

en: However, RGF counterfactual augmentation has impressive gains in consistency both on prior datasets and the two subsets we curated for reference and predicate perturbations.
zh: 然而，RGF反事实增强在先前的数据集和我们为引用和谓词扰动策划的两个子集上的一致性方面都取得了令人印象深刻的提高。

en: Note that the augmented RGF data is not biased by perturbation type, only the evaluation sets are.
zh: 请注意，增强RGF数据不会因扰动类型而产生偏差，只有评估集才会产生偏差。

en: For instance, this original question on the population of Walnut Grove, Minnesota is perturbed along different dimensions like town, state, country, and along different predicates like location, poverty, number of schools.
zh: 例如，这个关于明尼苏达州沃尔纳特格罗夫人口的原始问题在不同维度上受到扰动，如城镇、州、国家，以及不同的谓词，如位置、贫困、学校数量。

en: Augmentation improves out of domain generalization and neighborhood consistency.
zh: 增强改善了域外泛化和邻域一致性。

en: And we find that RGF counterfactuals are semantically diverse without introducing bias during augmentation.
zh: 我们发现，RGF反事实在语义上是多样化的，不会在增强过程中引入偏差。

en: I'm Allan from ByteDance AI Lab, and this is a joint work with Jierui Li from the University of Texas at Austin and Wei Lu from SUTD.
zh: 我是ByteDance 人工智能实验室的Allan，以下是我与德克萨斯大学奥斯汀分校的Jierui Li和SUTD的Wei Lu的合作成果。

en: So this figure is taken from the PaLM paper where they perform prompting to solve the network problem in the few shot learning scenario.
zh: 这个数字取自PaLM的论文，他们在这个论文中进行了提示，以解决少样本学习情况下的网络问题。

en: But the drawbacks are the performance is actually generally not better than the structured model and its lack of interpretability for prediction.
zh: 但缺点是，其表现实际上并不比结构化模型好，并且缺乏用于预测的可解释性。

en: So here the good thing is that it actually gives us this binary tree structure, and it is um but actually it is quite counterintuitive because we generate the operator first and then at the end we generate the quantities.
zh: 这里的好处是，它实际上给了我们这个二进制树结构，但实际上它非常违反直觉，因为我们首先生成运算符，然后在最后生成数量。

en: So in our model implementations, we first use a pretrained language model which can be BERTs or Robertas and then we encode the sentence and then we obtain these quantity representations.
zh: 在我们的模型实现中，我们首先使用预训练语言模型，它可以是BERTs或Robertas，然后我们编码句子，然后我们得到这些数量陈述。

en: So we conduct experiments on the commonly used math word problem datasets, MAWPS, Math23K,  MathQA and SVAMP.
zh: 我们对常用的数学文字问题 数据集、MAWPS、Math23K、MathQA和SVAMP进行实验。

en: But we can see the absolute numbers on MathQA or SVAMP are not really high.
zh: 但我们可以看到，MathQA或SVAMP上的绝对数字并不高。

en: So we further investigate the results on SVAMP.
zh: 我们进一步研究SVAMP的结果。

en: So um we further find such constraint actually improves quite a lot for some models.
zh: 我们进一步发现，针对某些模型，这种约束实际上改善了很多。

en: For example, for BERT, we improve seven points and then for the Roberta base model we actually improved two points.
zh: 例如，对于BERT，我们提高了7分。然后，对于Roberta基础模型，我们实际上提高了两分。

en: So better language model has better language understanding abilities so that the number here is higher for Roberta and lower for BERT.
zh: 因此，更好的语言模型具有更好的语言理解能力，因此，这里的数字对于Roberta来说更高，对于BERT来说更低。

en: So ah here we can see that ah,we have the the percentage of samples with unused quantities, and the SVAMP dataset has the largest portion.
zh: 在这里我们可以看到，我们有未使用数量的样本的百分比，其中SVAMP数据集占了最大的部分。

en: For MAWPS, we don't we don't really have ah too many test cases, so I just ignore this part.
zh: 对于MAWPS，我们其实没有太多的测试例子，所以我会忽略掉这一部分。

en: So, finally we want to show the interpretability through a question perturbation example.
zh: 最后，我们想通过一个问题扰动的例子来展示可解释性。

en: So, we make it to convey more accurate semantics such that the model is able to make um the prediction correct.
zh: 我们使其传达更准确的语义，以便模型能够使预测正确。

en: And we can easily incorporate some prior knowledge as constraint which can help improve the performance.
zh: 我们可以简单地将一些先前的知识作为约束，这样就可以帮助提高表现。

en: This difference in language distributions makes it harder for a system to retrieve relevant candidates, as it indirectly requires an inherent interpretation system that can translate a natural question to a legal question that matches the terminology of statutes.
zh: 这种语言分布的差异使得系统更难检索到相关候选信息，因为它间接需要一个固有的解释系统，可以将自然问题翻译成与法规术语相匹配的法律问题。

en: Instead, it's a structured collection of legal provisions that have a whole meaning only when considered in the overall context, that is, together with the supplementary information from the neighboring articles, the fields and subfields they belong to, and their place in the structure of the law.
zh: 相反，它是法律条款的结构化集合，只有在整体上下文中考虑时才具有完整的意义，也就是说，连同相邻条款的补充信息，它们所属的字段和子字段，以及它们在法律结构中的位置。

en: Our Belgian statutory article retrieval dataset BSARD consists of more than one thousand one hundred legal questions posed by Belgian citizens.
zh: 我们的比利时法定条款检索数据集BSARD由比利时公民提出的1100多个法律问题组成。

en: Given a query and an article, a lexical model assigns a score to the query article pair by computing the sum over the query terms of the weights of each of these terms in that article.
zh: 给定一个查询和一个条款，词汇模型通过计算该条款中每个术语的权重总和来为查询条款对分配一个分数。

en: We experiment with the standard TF-IDF and BM25 ranking functions.
zh: 我们使用标准的 TF-IDF和BM25排序函数进行实验。

en: To overcome this limitation, we experiment with a neural based architecture that can capture semantic relationships between queries and article.
zh: 为了克服这个限制，我们尝试了一种基于神经的架构，它可以捕获查询和条款之间的语义关系。

en: We experiment with context independent text encoder, namely word2vec and fastText, and context dependent embedding models, namely Roberta and more specifically CamemBERT which is a French Roberta model.
zh: 我们尝试了与上下文无关的文本编码器，即word2vec和fastText，以及上下文相关的嵌入模型，即Roberta，更具体地说是CamemBERT，它是个法语Roberta模型。

en: Additionally, we train our own CamemBERT based model ah bi-encoders on our dataset.
zh: 此外，我们在数据集上训练我们自己的基于CamemBERT的 模型双编码器。

en: We experiment with mean, max and CLS pooling as well as product and cosine for computing similarities.
zh: 我们试验了均值、最大值和CLS集合，以及计算相似性的乘积和余弦。

en: Regarding the zero shot evaluation of Siamese bi-encoder, we find that directly using the embeddings of a pretrained CamemBERT model without optimizing for the information retrieval task gives poor results, which is consistent with previous findings.
zh: 关于siamese双编码器的零样本评估，我们发现直接使用预训练的CamemBERT模型的嵌入，而不对信息检索任务进行优化，结果很差，这与之前的发现一致。

en: Furthermore, we observe that the word2vec based bi-encoder significantly outperformed the fastText and BERT based models, suggesting that maybe pretrained word level embeddings are more appropriate for the task than character level or subword level embeddings when used out of the box.
zh: 此外，我们观察到，基于word2vec的双编码器的表现明显优于基于fastText和BERT的模型，这表明在直接使用时，也许预训练的词级嵌入比字符级或子词级嵌入对这项任务更适合。

en: Hello, we are happy to present our work on VALSE; a Task-Independent Benchmark meant for testing vision and language models with specific linguistic phenomena.
zh: 大家好，很高兴向你们介绍我们的工作成果——VALSE，这是一个独立于任务的基准，旨在用特定的语言现象测试视觉和语言模型。

en: Each one of these models pushes state-of-the-art on vision and language tasks such as visual question answering, visual common sense reasoning, image retrieval, phrase grounding.
zh: 这些模型中的每一个都在视觉和语言任务上推动了最先进的技术，如视觉问题回答、视觉常识推理、图像检索，以及短语领域。

en: To shed more light on this aspect, we propose a more task agnostic direction and introduce VALSE that tests the sensitivity of vision and language models to specific linguistic phenomena that affect both the linguistic and the visual modalities.
zh: 为了进一步阐明这方面的问题，我们提出了一个与任务更加无关的方向，并引入VALSE，对于影响语言和视觉形态的特定语言现象，其测试视觉和语言模型的敏感性。

en: And we do these phrase alterations by focusing on six specific pieces such as existence, plurality, counting, spatial relations, actions and entity coreference, where each piece can consist of one or more instruments, in case we found more than one interesting way to create foil instances.
zh: 当我们在做这些短语改动时，重点关注了六个具体的方面，如存在性、复数、计数、空间关系、动作和实体共指，其中每个方面都可能包含一种或多种工具，以备我们发现不止一个有趣的方式来创造干扰实例。

en: For example, in the case of the actions piece, we have two instruments, one in which the action verb is changed with a different action, and one in which actants are swapped.
zh: 例如，在动作方面，我们有两种工具，在一种当中是用不同的动作改变动作动词，在另一种当中是动作被交换。

en: Therefore, as a third measure for generating valid foils, we employ human annotators to validate the data used in VALSE.
zh: 所以，作为生成有效干扰词的第三项措施，我们使用人类 注释着来验证VALSE中使用的数据。

en: Note that VALSE does not deliver any training data but only test data.
zh: 请注意，VALSE不提供任何训练数据，而仅提供测试数据。

en: Since it is a zero shot testing benchmark only, it is designed to leverage the existing capabilities of vision and language models after pretraining.
zh: 由于它仅是一个零样本测试基准，因此它旨在利用预训练后的视觉和语言模型的现存功能。

en: And as we said, we are interested in assessing what capabilities the vision and language models have after pretraining.
zh: 正如我们所说，我们有兴趣评估视觉和语言模型在预训练后具有哪些能力。

en: We experiment with five vision and language models on VALSE, namely with CLIP, LXMert, ViLBERT, ViLBERT twelve in one, and VisualBERT.
zh: 我们在VALSE上尝试了五种视觉和语言模型，即使用CLIP、LXMert、ViLBERT、ViLBERT十二合一和VisualBERT。

en: The results with pairwise accuracy are shown here and they are consistent with the results we got from the other metrics is that the best zero shot performance is achieved by ViLBERT twelve in one, followed by ViLBERT, LXMert, CLIP, and finally VisualBERT.
zh: 这里显示了成对的准确度的结果，它们与我们从其他指标中得到的结果一致，即ViLBERT十二分之一取得了最佳的零样本表现，其次是ViLBERT、LXMert、CLIP，最后是VisualBERT。

en: It's notable how instruments centered on the individual objects like existence and noun phrases are almost solved by ViLBERT twelve in one, highlighting that models are capable of identifying named objects and their presence in images.
zh: 值得注意的是，以个别对象（如存在性和名词短语）为中心的工具几乎被ViLBERT十二分之一解决了，这突出表明模型能够识别已命名的对象和它们在图片中的存在。

en: However, none of the remaining pieces can be reliably solved in our adversarial foiling settings.
zh: 但是，在我们的对抗性干扰设置中，其余的部分都不能被可靠地解决。

en: The relation piece shows that they have difficulties in correctly classifying a named spatial relation between objects in an image.
zh: 关系部分表明，它们难以正确地分类图像中对象之间的命名空间关系。

en: From the coreference piece, we find out that tracing multiple references to the same object in an image by using pronouns is also difficult for vision and language models.
zh: 从核心推理这一块，我们发现通过使用代词来追踪对图像中同一对象的多个引用，对于视觉和语言模型来说也是困难的。

en: As a sanity check, and because it's an interesting experiment, we also benchmark two text only models, GPT one and GPT two, to assess whether VALSE is solvable by these unimodal models by computing the perplexity of the correct and the foiled caption, no image here, and predicting the entry with the lowest perplexity.
zh: 作为理智的检查，同时也因为这是一个有趣的实验，我们还对两个纯文本模型（GPT one和GPT two）进行了基准测试，以评估VALSE是否可由这些单模态模型解决，方法是抛开图像不管，计算正确标题和受干扰标题的困惑度，并预测具有最低困惑度的条目。

en: And it's interesting to see that in some cases, the text only GPT models have captured the plausibility of the world better than the vision and language models.
zh: 有趣的是，在某些情况下，纯文本的GPT模型比视觉和语言模型更好地捕捉了世界的合理性。

en: So to sum up, VALSE is a benchmark that uses the lens of linguistic constructs to help the community improve vision and language models by hard testing their visual grounding capabilities.
zh: 因此，总的来说，VALSE是一个基准，它使用语言构造的镜头，通过硬性测试社区的视觉接地能力，来帮助其改善视觉和语言模型。

en: We would really like to encourage the community to use VALSE for measuring progress towards language grounding with vision and language models.
zh: 我们非常希望鼓励社区使用VALSE来衡量用视觉和语言模型实现语言接地的进展。

en: And even more, VALSE could be used as an indirect assessment of datasets, as models could be evaluated before and after training or finetuning to see whether a dataset helps models improve on any of the aspects tested by VALSE.
zh: 更重要的是，VALSE可以作为数据集的间接评估，因为可以在训练或微调前后对模型进行评估，以了解数据集是否有助于模型在VALSE测试的任何方面得到改善。

en: If you're interested, do check out the VALSE data on GitHub, and if you have any questions do not hesitate to contact us.
zh: 如果您有兴趣，请查看GitHub上的VALSE数据。如果您有任何疑问，请随时与我们联系。

en: I'll be presenting a paper entitled RNSum: A Large-Scale Dataset for Automatic Release Note Generation via Commit Logs Summarization.
zh: 我将发表一篇论文，题目为《RNSum：通过提交日志总结自动生成发行说明的大规模数据集》。

en: The first is a system called ARENA released in twenty fourteen.
zh: 第一个是被称为ARENA的系统 ，发布于2014年。

en: It takes a rule-based approach, for example using the change extractor to extract all differences, library changes and document changes from the differences between releases, and finally combining them.
zh: 它采取了一种基于规则的方法，例如使用变化提取器从不同版本的差异中提取所有的差异、库的变化和文件的变化，最后再将它们结合起来。

en: The most notable feature of this system is the issue extractor in the upper right corner.
zh: 这个系统最显著的特征是右上角的问题提取器。

en: It is available on the internet and can be installed via pip.
zh: 它可以在互联网上下载，并可以通过pip安装。

en: For the second problem of scarce data resources, we built our RNSum dataset consisting of about eighty two thousand pieces of data by collecting data from public GitHub repositories using the GitHub API.
zh: 对于第二个数据资源稀缺的问题，我们通过使用GitHub API从公共GitHub存储库收集数据，建立了由大约八万两千条数据组成的RNSum数据集。

en: We created a heuristic matching rule to get the previous and next versions.
zh: 我们创建了一个启发式匹配规则来获取上一个和下一个版本。

en: The classwise extractive then abstractive summarization model consists of two neural modules.
zh: 这个先按类别抽取然后抽象总结的模型是由两个神经模块组成的。

en: A classifier using BERT or CodeBERT and a generator using BART.
zh: 一个是使用BERT或CodeBERT的分类器，另一个是使用BART的生成器。

en: First, CEAS uses a classifier to classify each commit message into five release notes classes, which use improvements, bug fixes, deprecations, plus an other.
zh: 首先，CEAS使用分类器将每条提交信息分为五个发行说明类别，其中使用了“改进”、“错误修复”、“弃用”，以及“其他”。

en: Then CEAS applies the generator to the four labeled documents independently and generates release notes for each class.
zh: 然后CEAS将生成器独立地应用于四个标签化 文档，并为每个类别生成发行说明。

en: The first model, which we call CAS-Single, consists of a single six to six network and generates a single release note text give a concatenation of input commit messages.
zh: 第一种方法是我们称为CAS-Single的模型，它由一个单一的六对六网络组成，并生成一个单一的发行说明文本，给出输入提交信息的串联。

en: The second method, method, which we call CAS-Multi, consists of four different seq2seq networks, each of which correspond to one of the fixed release note classes.
zh: 第二种方法，方法，我们称之为CAS-Multi，由四个不同的seq2seq网络组成，每个网络都对应于一个固定的发行说明类别。

en: Five methods were compared: CEAS, CAS-Single, CAS-Multi, Clustering, and previous study, Glyph.
zh: 我们比较了五种方法：CEAS、CAS-Single、CAS-Multi、Clustering，以及之前的研究“Glyph”。

en: The BLEU is penalized when the system outputs a short sentence.
zh: 当系统输出一个短句时，BLEU会受到惩罚。

en: This penalty results in a lower BLEU value in the experiment results described next.
zh: 在接下来描述的实验结果中，这种惩罚导致了较低的BLEU值。

en: Finally, we also calculate the specificity because ROUGE and BLEU cannot be calculated if the release notes are empty.
zh: 最后，我们还计算了特异性，因为如果发行说明是空的，就无法计算ROUG和BLEU。

en: CEAS and CAS achieved ROUGE-L scores more than ten points higher than the baselines.
zh: CEAS和CAS的ROUGE-L得分比基线高10分以上。

en: These results indicate that CEAS and CAS are significantly affected.
zh: 这些结果表明CEAS和CAS受到严重影响。

en: CEAS got a better ROUGE-L score than CAS suggesting that combining a classifier and a generator is effective on training the classifier using pseudo labels.
zh: CEAS比CAS得到了更好的ROUGE-L分数，这表明将分类器和生成器结合在一起对使用伪标签训练分类器是有效的。

en: High coverage of CEAS can be achieved probably because the classifier can focus on selecting relevant commit messages for each class.
zh: CEAS的高覆盖率之所以能够实现，可能是因为分类器可以专注于为每个类别选择相关的提交信息。

en: CAS-Multi tended to yield higher ROUGE-L than CAS-Single.
zh: CAS -Multi倾向于比CAS -Single产生更高的ROUGE -L。

en: CAS methods tend to output shorter sentences than human reference sentences.
zh: CAS方法倾向于输出比人类参考句子更短的句子。

en: In the figure on the right, the reference sentence has three or four sentences, while CAS has only one.
zh: 在右图中，引用句子有3或4个句子 ，而CAS只有1个。

en: Furthermore, CAS methods cannot generate accurate release notes without additional information.
zh: 此外，如果没有额外的信息，CAS方法就无法生成准确的发行说明。

en: And I will present our paper, Few-Shot Tabular Data Enrichment Using Fine-Tuned Transformers Architectures.
zh: 我将介绍我们的论文《使用微调转换器架构的少样本表格式数据充实》。

en: Our framework FeSTE is exactly this automatic process.
zh: 我们的框架FeSTE正是这个自动过程。

en: So let's see an example in a dataset fed into FeSTE.
zh: 我们来看看在一个数据集中输入FeSTE的例子。

en: The first phase of FeSTE is entity linking.
zh: FeSTE的第一阶段是实体链接。

en: So, we need to ah feature extraction phase ah which includes text analysis.
zh: 因此，我们需要进行特征提取阶段，其中包括文本分析。

en: After the feature extraction phase, there is a feature generation phase when we use the extracted features to generate a small number of new features.
zh: 在特征提取阶段之后，还有一个特征生成阶段，我们使用提取的特征来生成少量的新特征。

en: So, FeSTE generates two new features.
zh: 所以，FeSTE生成两个特征。

en: But if the dataset has five classes, FeSTE generates five new features.
zh: 但如果数据集有五个类，FeSTE就会生成五个新的特征。

en: To analyze the text, we use the current state-of-the-art of text analysis, which are transformer based language models as BERT, GPT,  XLNet and etc.
zh: 为了分析文本，我们使用了目前最先进的文本分析方法，即基于转换器的语言模型，如BERT、GPT、XLNet等。

en: So, in the feature extraction phase, we can download pretrained language models, finetune the language model over the target dataset.
zh: 因此，在特征提取阶段，我们可以下载预训练的语言模型，在目标数据集上微调语言模型。

en: Because FeSTE, we apply FeSTE over a multiple dataset, we can use the n minus one datasets to gather information about the n minus one datasets, and use this information when we analyze the nth dataset.
zh: 因为FeSTE，我们在多个数据集上应用FeSTE，我们可以使用n减1的数据集来收集n减1的数据集的信息，并在分析第n个数据集时使用这些信息。

en: The state-of-the-art in multitask ah multitask finetuning called MTDNN.
zh: 最先进的多任务多任务微调技术称为MTDNN。

en: In MTDNN, MTDNN maintains ah heads in the number of tasks in the training set.
zh: 在MTDNN中，MTDNN在训练集的任务数量上保持着头部。

en: So, in this example there are four tasks in the training set, so MTDNN maintain four heads as you can see at the image.
zh: 因此，在这个例子中，训练集里有四个任务，所以MTDNN维持四个头，正如在图像上看到的那样。

en: MTDNN maintained number of classes, heads, output layers.
zh: MTDNN保持了类、头、输出层的数量。

en: And the additional, additionally MTDNN needs to initialize new heads for a new dataset with a new task.
zh: 另外，MTDNN需要为一个新的数据集和一个新的任务初始化新的头。

en: Dataset fed into FeSTE.
zh: 数据集送入FeSTE。

en: And then ah FeSTE executes entity linking phase.
zh: 然后，FeSTE执行实体链接阶段。

en: We design our experiment as leave one out ah evaluation where we train FeSTe over sixteen datasets and apply it to the seventeenth dataset.
zh: 我们将实验设计为留出一个评估，在16个数据集上训练FeSTe，并将其应用于第17个数据集。

en: Then, we generate the new features and evaluate them using five evaluation classifiers.
zh: 然后，我们生成新的特征，并使用五个评估分类器对其进行评估。

en: We use in our experiments base BERT base architecture.
zh: 在我们的实验中，我们使用基础BERT基础架构。

en: You can see that we compare our our framework to target dataset finetuning, target task finetuning, and a MTDNN preliminary finetuning.
zh: 你可以看到，我们将我们的框架与目标数据集微调……目标数据集微调和MTDNN初步微调进行了比较。

en: While MTDNN achieved two percent improvement over the target dataset finetuning.
zh: 而MTDNN比目标 数据集 微调提高了2%。

en: When we look on the small ah dataset, we can see that the performance of MTDNN decreases and the improvement of the prelim, the preliminary multitask finetuning phase decreases to one point five percent.
zh: 当我们在小数据集上看时，我们可以看到MTDNN的表现下降了，初步的多任务微调阶段的改进下降到1.5%。

en: For summing, FeSTE enables few shot enrichment from thirty five samples in our experiments.
zh: 总而言之，在我们的实验中，FeSTE可以从35个样品中进行少量的富集。
